announcement: A new home for Algerian craft — the first collection is being prepared.

home.heroTitle: Made by hand. Remembered for generations.
home.heroBody: A considered destination for objects shaped by place, patience, and the hands that know them best.
home.imageAlt: Handmade terracotta vessel, woven textile, and hammered brass in an Algerian workshop
home.collectionBody: Product stories will appear here when the catalogue integration is available.
home.storyTitle: The maker belongs at the centre of the story.
home.storyBody: AISHA is being designed around provenance: who made an object, where its language comes from, and why its methods matter.
home.artisansBody: Portraits and verified workshop stories will be connected here when public artisan data is available.
home.valuesTitle: A quieter way to discover craft
home.valueOriginBody: Origin and cultural context are designed to remain visible, not buried in metadata.
home.valueQualityBody: Generous space, clear typography, and restrained controls keep attention on the work.
home.valuePeopleBody: The storefront is structured to introduce the artisan alongside every object.
home.finalBody: Return as the first AISHA collection and its makers are introduced.

footer.story: An editorial storefront for Algerian craftsmanship, its makers, materials, and origins.
